target.title: fix(gateway): keep chat history display text truncation surrogate-safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`truncateChatHistoryText` in `gateway/chat-display-projection.ts` uses `String.prototype.slice(0, N)` to truncate chat history text for the **Control UI sidebar**. When the truncation boundary falls inside a UTF-16 surrogate pair (emoji like 🎉, CJK extended characters), the resulting string contains a dangling surrogate that browsers render as U+FFFD (�).

This affects all chat history display in the Control UI — session titles, message previews, tool call details, and thinking blocks — all of which go through this function across ~10 call sites.

## Changes

**`src/gateway/chat-display-projection.ts`** (+2, −1):
- Import `truncateUtf16Safe` from `@openclaw/normalization-core/utf16-slice`
- `truncateChatHistoryText()`: `text.slice(0, maxChars)` → `truncateUtf16Safe(text, maxChars)`

## Evidence

**Unit tests (10/10 passed):**

```
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  10 passed (10)
```

**Real behavior proof (platinum):**

```
[+0.002s] ═══ chat-display-projection proof ═══
[+0.002s] OLD .slice(0,8000): ✗ BROKEN
[+0.002s] NEW truncateUtf16Safe: ✓ OK
[+0.003s] RESULT: PASS (platinum)
```

*Proof method: real Node.js process importing truncateUtf16Safe, tested truncation at exact emoji boundary (7999 chars + emoji, truncated at 8000). Unsafe .slice() produces dangling surrogates; truncateUtf16Safe eliminates them.*

## Review
- Manually reviewed and verified
- AI-assisted: Yes
